title: Cycle count shows Not Tracked with no count input for an untracked part
custom_preconds:
• Sign in to sv10647.qa.shopview.com (or the release env) as Admin; location Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • At least one untracked part exists (Track quantities and cost of goods switched off), with a bin quantity.
  • Parts > Inventory, Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Search the untracked part number so its row is on screen.
  2. Click the ⋮ menu next to New Inventory Part, then Cycle count.
  3. Type a count on a tracked row (if one is on screen), then click Cancel.
custom_expected:
Step 2:

  • The untracked row's Count cell reads Not Tracked in grey (text_count_not_tracked_{id}).
  • There is no count input on that row.
  • "Count changes available" stays at its starting value for the untracked row.

Step 3:

  • Only the tracked row changes "Count changes available"; the untracked row never counts.
